\section*{AP \({ }^{\text {® }}\) CALCULUS BC \\ 2010 SCORING GUIDELINES (Form B)}

\section*{Question 2}

The velocity vector of a particle moving in the plane has components given by
\[
\frac{d x}{d t}=14 \cos \left(t^{2}\right) \sin \left(e^{t}\right) \text { and } \frac{d y}{d t}=1+2 \sin \left(t^{2}\right), \text { for } 0 \leq t \leq 1.5 .
\]
At time \(t=0\), the position of the particle is (-2, 3).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] For \(0<t<1.5\), find all values of \(t\) at which the line tangent to the path of the particle is vertical.
\item[(b)] Write an equation for the line tangent to the path of the particle at \(t=1\).
\item[(c)] Find the speed of the particle at \(t=1\).
\item[(d)] Find the acceleration vector of the particle at \(t=1\).
\item[(a)] The tangent line is vertical when \(x^{\prime}(t)=0\) and \(y^{\prime}(t) \neq 0\). On \(0<t<1.5\), this happens at \(t=1.253\) and \(t=1.144\) or 1.145.
\item[(b)] \(\left.\frac{d y}{d x}\right|_{t=1}=\frac{y^{\prime}(1)}{x^{\prime}(1)}=0.863447\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
& x(1)=-2+\int_{0}^{1} x^{\prime}(t) d t=9.314695 \\
& y(1)=3+\int_{0}^{1} y^{\prime}(t) d t=4.620537
\end{aligned}
\]
The line tangent to the path of the particle at \(t=1\) has equation \(y=4.621+0.863(x-9.315)\).
\item[(c)] Speed \(=\sqrt{\left(x^{\prime}(1)\right)^{2}+\left(y^{\prime}(1)\right)^{2}}=4.105\)
\item[(d)] Acceleration vector: \(\left\langle x^{\prime \prime}(1), y^{\prime \prime}(1)\right\rangle=\langle-28.425,2.161\rangle\)
\end{itemize}

2 : \(\left\{\begin{array}{l}1 \text { : sets } \frac{d x}{d y}=0 \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\(4:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1:\left.\frac{d y}{d x}\right|_{t=1} \\ 1: x(1) \\ 1: y(1) \\ 1: \text { equation }\end{array}\right.\)

1 : answer
\(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: x^{\prime \prime}(1) \\ 1: y^{\prime \prime}(1)\end{array}\right.\)
